description: One of your tokens by type and id (from gluecron_list_tokens): everything list shows plus the audit trail (create, edits with a before/after diff, rotations, revocation). Never the secret. `type` is pat (personal access token, glc_), repo (repository token, gcft_) or deploy (deploy token, gcdt_). Same scopes as gluecron_list_tokens.

type.description: Token type: pat (personal access token, glc_), repo (repository token, gcft_) or deploy (deploy token, gcdt_)

name: gluecron_get_token
